user.title: Set up voix
user.description: Adds two HA voice features: a dictation conversation agent (writes the transcript to a helper, no spoken reply) and an OpenAI Realtime bridge (STT + TTS engines that bridge any HA Assist pipeline to OpenAI Realtime, with multi-turn). Both are hardware-agnostic — point any HA Assist satellite at them.

data.dictation_helper: Helper entity to write dictation transcripts to (input_text.*)
data.led_ring_entity: Satellite LED ring entity to flash on dictation capture (light.*)
data.openai_api_key: OpenAI API key (leave blank to disable Mode B / Realtime)
data.realtime_voice: Realtime voice (e.g. alloy, verse, sage, marin)
data.realtime_instructions: System instructions for the Realtime assistant

init.title: voix configuration
init.description: Edit defaults and modes. Per-device settings (which mode is currently active, wake words) live as entities on each Voice PE device.

menu_options.defaults: Defaults (API keys, default mode, idle timeout)
menu_options.modes: Modes (each one has its own prompt, voice, STT provider, color, and context)

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Settings that apply when a mode doesn't override them. OpenAI key is required for realtime conversations and for streaming dictation transcription.

data.idle_timeout_s: Idle timeout (seconds without activity → session closes)

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: Pick a mode to edit, or add a new one. Each mode bundles a behavior type (realtime / dictation), a system prompt, voice, model, and LED color.

mode_form.title: Edit mode: {name}
mode_form.description: Each mode defines how the voix wake word behaves. Realtime modes hold a live OpenAI conversation; dictation modes transcribe speech to a file. Each mode has its own prompt + context, so "Work" and "Home" can be totally separate.

data.name: Display name
data.prompt: System prompt (the model's instructions; realtime only)
data.voice: Realtime voice (leave blank to use the default)
data.model: Realtime model (leave blank to use the default)
data.include_entities: Always-include entities (model sees their state in every prompt)
data.addendum: Addendum (freeform text appended to the system prompt)

abort.cannot_delete_last: Can't delete the last remaining mode. Add another one first.

error.invalid: One or more fields are invalid. Check the values and try again.

cycle_mode.name: Cycle mode
cycle_mode.description: Advance the voix mode select to the next mode in the catalog. Wraps at the end.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Target a specific Voice PE if you have multiple. Omit for single-device installs.

set_mode.name: Set mode
set_mode.description: Directly set the voix mode for a device.

mode.name: Mode ID
mode.description: ID of a mode from the catalog (e.g. 'default-realtime').

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: Target a specific Voice PE. Omit for single-device installs.

create_mode.name: Create mode
create_mode.description: Add a new mode to the catalog. Mostly used by the Tauri app.

color.name: Color
color.description: LED color as [R, G, B] (0–255 each).

update_mode.name: Update mode
update_mode.description: Modify an existing mode in the catalog.

mode_id.name: Mode ID
mode_id.description: ID of the mode to update.

delete_mode.name: Delete mode
delete_mode.description: Remove a mode from the catalog.

mode_id.name: Mode ID
mode_id.description: ID of the mode to delete.

get_transcript.name: Get transcript
get_transcript.description: Read the contents of a transcript file. Pass the filepath from a transcript sensor's state.

list_modes.name: List modes
list_modes.description: Return the full mode catalog with prompt/voice/model/color/brightness/effect — for the desktop app's editor.
